sharedContractNote: Fields here are Farside-local. Dashmeta 0.11.0 was read in E1-S2 (`docs/scan-contracts.md`); this spec is not a dashmeta schema. Do not invent dashmeta field names.
statusRule: An entry is unverified until a dated live run exists. Unverified entries are labelled not-supported. Live verification is E1-S7.

checks.title: All resources by subscription, type, and region
checks.dataSource: Azure Resource Graph `Resources` table (resource id, type, location, subscriptionId)

undetermined.when: Resource Graph returns incomplete or forbidden results for a subscription
undetermined.closer: Grant Reader on that subscription and a successful ARG query

checks.title: Resources with no owner tag
checks.dataSource: Azure Resource Graph `Resources` tags column; owner tag name is a Settings value

undetermined.when: The owner tag key has not been configured for the org
undetermined.closer: Set the owner tag key in Settings

undetermined.when: Tags are not returned for a resource type
undetermined.closer: A Resource Graph row for that type that includes tags

checks.title: Unattached disks
checks.dataSource: Azure Resource Graph / Microsoft.Compute/disks where diskState is Unattached (or managedBy is empty)
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of the unused disk SKU and size, as a range

undetermined.when: diskState or managedBy is missing on a disk row
undetermined.closer: A disk read that includes diskState and managedBy

undetermined.when: No price for that SKU and region is available
undetermined.closer: A retail or agreement price row for the SKU in that region

checks.title: Unassociated public IPs
checks.dataSource: Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses where ipConfiguration is empty
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of the unused public IP SKU, as a range

undetermined.when: Association properties are not returned
undetermined.closer: A public IP read that includes ipConfiguration / natGateway / associated resource

checks.title: Old snapshots
checks.dataSource: Microsoft.Compute/snapshots with timeCreated older than the org retention threshold
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of snapshot storage for the retained size, as a range

undetermined.when: The retention threshold is not configured
undetermined.closer: Set snapshot retention days in Settings

undetermined.when: timeCreated is missing
undetermined.closer: A snapshot read that includes timeCreated

checks.title: VMs stopped but not deallocated
checks.dataSource: Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines instance view powerState (stopped vs deallocated)
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly compute list price of the VM size while stopped-but-allocated, as a range

undetermined.when: Instance view / powerState is not available
undetermined.closer: A VM instance-view read that includes powerState

checks.title: Empty App Service plans
checks.dataSource: Microsoft.Web/serverfarms with numberOfSites = 0 (or no Microsoft.Web/sites on the plan)
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of the empty plan SKU, as a range

undetermined.when: numberOfSites is missing and site-to-plan links cannot be listed
undetermined.closer: A plan read that includes numberOfSites, or a complete sites list

checks.title: Idle load balancers
checks.dataSource: Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers with no backend addresses, plus Monitoring Reader metrics if traffic is required to call it idle
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of the unused load balancer SKU, as a range

undetermined.when: Backend pools are not returned
undetermined.closer: A load balancer read that includes backend address pools

undetermined.when: Idle is defined by traffic and metrics are missing
undetermined.closer: Monitoring Reader and a metric series for the balancer

checks.title: Idle NAT gateways
checks.dataSource: Microsoft.Network/natGateways with no attached subnets, plus Monitoring Reader metrics if traffic is required
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of the unused NAT gateway, as a range

undetermined.when: Subnet associations are not returned
undetermined.closer: A NAT gateway read that includes subnets

checks.title: Spend by service
checks.dataSource: Cost Management Query API, grouped by ServiceName for the selected billing scope and currency

undetermined.when: The billing scope (subscription, billing account, or MCA profile) cannot be resolved
undetermined.closer: Cost Management Reader on the right billing scope

undetermined.when: Currency or amortised vs actual cost is not stated on the response
undetermined.closer: A query that returns currency and cost type

checks.title: Month-on-month spend change
checks.dataSource: Cost Management Query API for the current and previous full months at the same billing scope and currency

undetermined.when: Fewer than two complete months of cost data exist
undetermined.closer: Two complete months of Cost Management data at that scope

checks.title: Reservation use
checks.dataSource: Reservations Summaries / Benefits utilisation APIs (usedHours vs reservedHours, coverage)
checks.savingsBasis: Unused committed reservation spend for the period, as a range

undetermined.when: Reservations Reader is missing or the billing account is not in scope
undetermined.closer: Reservations Reader on the billing account that owns the reservation

checks.title: Savings plan use
checks.dataSource: Savings plan utilisation APIs (committed amount vs used amount)
checks.savingsBasis: Unused committed savings-plan spend for the period, as a range

undetermined.when: Savings plan utilisation is not returned
undetermined.closer: A benefits utilisation read that includes the savings plan

checks.title: Subscriptions without budgets
checks.dataSource: Cost Management budgets API listed per subscription

undetermined.when: Budgets cannot be listed for a subscription
undetermined.closer: Cost Management Reader and a successful budgets list on that subscription

checks.title: Production VMs outside Azure Backup
checks.dataSource: Recovery Services vault backup items (VM) compared to VMs tagged or marked production in Settings

undetermined.when: The production marker is not configured
undetermined.closer: Set the production tag or name pattern in Settings

undetermined.when: Vault items cannot be listed
undetermined.closer: Backup Reader on the vaults in scope

checks.title: Production SQL outside Azure Backup
checks.dataSource: Recovery Services / backup items for Azure SQL compared to production SQL servers or databases

undetermined.when: SQL backup items cannot be listed
undetermined.closer: Backup Reader on the relevant vaults and a list of SQL backup items

checks.title: Databases without zone redundancy or geo-backup
checks.dataSource: Azure SQL / Cosmos / MySQL / PostgreSQL properties: zoneRedundant, geoRedundantBackup / backup storage redundancy

undetermined.when: Zone or backup redundancy properties are not returned for an engine
undetermined.closer: A database read that includes those properties for that engine

checks.title: Retiring SKUs
checks.dataSource: Resource SKU plus Azure retirement / service health announcements matched by SKU or resource type

undetermined.when: No retirement catalogue is available for that SKU
undetermined.closer: A dated retirement announcement or SKU retirement list that includes the SKU

checks.title: Expiring App Service certificates
checks.dataSource: Microsoft.Web/certificates (and custom hostname bindings) expirationDate

undetermined.when: expirationDate is missing on a certificate or binding
undetermined.closer: A certificate read that includes expirationDate

checks.title: Expiring gateway certificates
checks.dataSource: Application Gateway / Front Door / API Management SSL certificate expiry

undetermined.when: Gateway certificate expiry is not returned
undetermined.closer: A gateway HTTPS listener / custom domain read that includes certificate expiry
